caption:
POV: You’ve been daydreaming about this Summer Market Charcuterie Dip all week!🍯 

Juicy blackberries and peaches, melty Brie, crispy prosciutto, fresh thyme, Marcona almonds, and a drizzle of hot garlic honey all baked together until warm and gooey!🫠

Sweet, salty, savory, and just a little spicy. 🔥

SUMMER MARKET CHARCUTERIE DIP
Serves 2-4
What you’ll need:  
8 oz Brie, cut into large cubes
1/4 cup fresh blackberries
1/2 medium peach, diced
2 oz prosciutto, torn into pieces
¼ cup Marcona almonds, roughly chopped
1 tsp fresh thyme leaves
¼ tsp kosher salt
¼ tsp freshly cracked black pepper
½ cup hot garlic honey 🍯🤤 (comment yum and I’ll dm you the recipe)

Instructions: Heat oven to 375°F.

Add Brie, blackberries, peaches, and prosciutto to a small baking dish.

Season lightly with thyme, salt, and black pepper.

Drizzle with hot garlic honey and bake for 12–15 minutes, until the Brie is soft and gooey and the fruit is bubbling.

Finish with Marcona almonds, more fresh thyme, and an extra drizzle of hot garlic honey.

Serve immediately with toasted bread, crostini,or  crackers and enjoy!
author: Frohneats
transcript: If there's one thing you need to try this summer, then make it my summer market charcuterie dish. It's insanely delicious and so easy to make, combined in creamy brie, blackberries, peaches, prosciutto, fresh thyme, and a hot garlic honey. And I just top it with crunchy marcona almonds and pop it in the oven until it's golden and bubbly, and ooh la la, there you go, food fam. Full recipe in the caption.
title: Summer Market Charcuterie Dip Recipe
one_liner: A baked Brie dip with blackberries, peaches, prosciutto, and hot garlic honey, ready in under 20 minutes.
key_points: Brie cubes bake with fresh blackberries and diced peach until soft and gooey
Crispy prosciutto and Marcona almonds add salty crunch to balance the sweet fruit
Hot garlic honey drizzled before and after baking brings heat, sweetness, and depth
Serve immediately with crostini, toasted bread, or crackers for a crowd-ready summer appetizer
